description: Every ADS model element that participates in a cross-concern relationship, in one identity space.
provenance: Derived from the modelling tool's project export by tools/derive_from_export.py; identities and text verbatim. Element UUIDs follow the same per-kind rule as the platform's traceability resolver: SysML elements, FMEDA rows and fault-tree elements carry elementId, safety-case elements carry gid. Executable evidence models, and digital-twin mappings, have no UUID of their own and carry null. A traceability link with several targets contributes one edge per target, each carrying the link's name. Two edge kinds are read from the export's structure rather than its trace links: attribute-of (a telemetry-bound attribute to the part usages its owning definition types) and fta-fmeda (a basic event to the FMEDA row its description names). Edges and elements with origin 'completion' come from models/traceability/completion.json, authored to complete the thread and pending engineering review. A link from a failure-analysis element to a requirement carries a relation: challenges (the failure or event violates the requirement) or realises (the safety mechanism or control it names implements the requirement). A link from an FMEDA row to a design part carries the relation analyses and records the part the row's itemElement field names; where such a link exists, no field-derived fmeda-item edge is added. A link from a Modelica parameter to a SysML attribute carries the relation binds and records a Degree 0 value binding; where such a link exists, it is the binding's edge and no sim-binding edge is added. Three SysML attributes (changeoverPeriod, saturationTimeConstant, minDecontaminationFactor) and the Modelica parameters they set (tCycle, tSat, DFtarget) come from the completion overlay: parameter-of joins a parameter to the Modelica model that declares it, and sim-binding is a Degree 0 value binding from a parameter to the attribute whose value it takes. Both ends of a binding carry `value` (the SysML literal; the parameter's value as declared in the exported Modelica source), which must be equal; a bound attribute also carries its `qualifiedName`.
identity: `id` is the endpoint identifier the traceability links use. `uuid` is the element's own stable identifier, matching @id in the SysML, FMEDA, fault-tree and safety-case JSON exports, so a thread edge can be joined to the model that describes what it points at. Fault-tree elements are identified by their event and gate codes (TE-01, BE-12, G-04), which are their elementId.

concerns: Concern names group elements the way the article's link breakdown does, so the two count the same concern pairs. The five executable evidence models share one concern, `executable-evidence`, with the specific notation on each node's `notation` field. Failure analysis is likewise one concern, `failure-analysis`, holding the FMEDA rows (`notation` FMEDA) and the fault-tree events and gates (`notation` FTA).
